text:
A year ago Linus Ullmark was a problem in Ottawa: 13.3 goals worse than an average goalie on his shots across 49 games, by our measure. This season he's the reason the Senators win. He is 11-1-0 with a .941 save percentage and has saved 12.1 goals above expected (goals an average goalie would allow on his shots, minus what he actually allowed), 97th percentile, with 18 goals against on 30.1 expected. He's been good on every kind of shot, including .767 on high-danger chances against a league .684.

There was one interruption. He left an Oct. 21 game against Florida early and didn't start again until Nov. 12, and Yahoo Sports' headline since says Ottawa must manage his workload "With Ullmark Healthy And Rolling." He picked up his 200th win at Pittsburgh on Nov. 14. After Monday's win over Calgary, The Athletic's Julian McKenzie reported Ullmark admitted he felt "awful" after the first period and talked it through with backup Sam Ersson. Our talent range still expects his long-run save rate closer to league average than .941, so enjoy the run for what it is.
headline: Linus Ullmark is Ottawa's wall again
